info.title: API.SH: Steam
info.description: The Steam API from API.SH: public Steam data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Steam app by id or link, as sold in a country: name, type, free flag, age rating, price (initial, final, discount, formatted), packages and purchase options, short and full description, supported languages, developers, publishers, release date, platforms, genres, categories, Metacritic score, recommendation and achievement counts, review totals (positive, negative, percent, recent, monthly history), players in game now, DLC, controller support, content notes, PC/Mac/Linux requirements, website, images, screenshots and trailers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-app

get.description:
Community Market listings for one item or a search: item name, game, type, lowest listing price, number of listings, tradable and commodity flags and icon. With `item` (the exact market name) you get that item with its lowest price, median price and 24-hour volume. 50 per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-market-listings

parameters.description: Exact market name of one item, e.g. `AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)`. Needs `appid`.

parameters.description: Steam currency id (default 1 = USD, 2 = GBP, 3 = EUR).

get.description:
How many people are playing a Steam app right now.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-players

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
User reviews of a Steam app, 10 a page: recommended or not, hours on record (and at review time), posted date, text, helpful, funny and comment counts, early-access and free-copy flags, author (name, profile, Steam id, products in account, avatar) and review link. Sorted by most helpful (all time or in a window), most recent or funniest, in one language. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page. `review_type` keeps only positive or only negative reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-reviews

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: toprated = most helpful of all time (default); trend* = most helpful in that window.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language (Steam language name, default english), e.g. german, schinese, russian.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

parameters.name: review_type
parameters.description: `all` (default), `positive` (recommended only) or `negative` (not recommended only). Pass the same value with `cursor` for the next pages.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Steam store with its filters: keywords, sort, the store's lists (top sellers, global top sellers, new and trending, coming soon), specials, max price, tags, type, OS, language and feature category. Each result: app/bundle/package id, name, link, release date, review summary with positive percent and review count, price, original price, discount, platforms, tag ids and image. 50 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (optional when a filter, tags, type, category or specials is given).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: `free` or the highest price in whole units of the currency.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag ids that must all match, e.g. `492,19` (Indie, Action).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated feature category ids, e.g. 2 single-player, 1 multi-player, 9 co-op, 28 controller support.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: Store country (two letters, default us): prices and availability for that country.

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: Store language (Steam language name, default english), e.g. german, french, schinese, japanese.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Private profiles return only their public basics.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-user

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/steam-user-inventory

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
